principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class has multiple responsibilities: calculating the area of shapes and formatting output, which violates SRP.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate area calculation and output formatting into different classes.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class depends on concrete classes (Square, Circle) rather than abstractions, violating DIP.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use an interface or a common superclass for the shape classes to allow AreaCalculator to depend on abstractions.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
